overviewHtml:
Teams that want to archive Dynatrace data in AWS need a working example of the S3 actions before building their own workflow.

What you get

  • Listing of S3 buckets and creation of a dynatrace-bizevents bucket if missing
  • A DQL task that fetches the most recent business event
  • An S3 put object task that stores the event with a timestamp key
  • A CloudFormation template that creates the AWS role and identity provider
prereqsHtml:
• Dynatrace SaaS with Workflows and the AWS for Workflows app
  • An AWS account and the AWS CLI, with permission to create IAM resources
  • Business events in Grail
setupHtml:
1. Create the AWS resources with cloudformation-store-bizevents-in-s3-bucket.json. This is step 2 of the AWS for Workflows setup. The template creates:
  • an IAM identity provider that trusts identities issued by https://token.dynatrace.com;
  • an IAM role that trusts this provider, with inline policies for account:ListRegions, s3:PutObject, s3:ListAllMyBuckets and s3:CreateBucket.

Replace [TENANT-ID] and run:

   aws cloudformation create-stack --stack-name dynatrace-s3-workflow-example --template-url https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Dynatrace/community-examples/main/workflows/aws-s3-store-bizevents/cloudformation-store-bizevents-in-s3-bucket.json --parameters ParameterKey=TenantUrl,ParameterValue=[TENANT-ID].apps.dynatrace.com ParameterKey=ConnectionName,ParameterValue=S3-Example --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM

CloudFormation's --template-url normally expects an S3 URL. If AWS rejects the GitHub URL, download the file and use --template-body file://cloudformation-store-bizevents-in-s3-bucket.json instead.

  1. Create the connection in Dynatrace (step 3 of the setup). Name it S3-Example and use the ARN of the new role. Get the ARN with:
   aws iam list-roles --query 'Roles[?starts_with(RoleName, `DynatraceS3WorkflowExample`)].Arn'
  1. Import and run the workflow. Upload store-bizevent-in-s3-bucket.workflow-template.yaml in Workflows, select the S3-Example connection in the three S3 tasks, and choose Run.
getStartedHtml:
You need Dynatrace Workflows with the AWS for Workflows app and an AWS account.

  1. Create the AWS resources with the CloudFormation template
  2. Create the connection in Dynatrace using the new role
  3. Upload the workflow, select the connection and run it
